descriptionChirho: The proper noun Paras in its gentilicized or national sense, referring to Persia or the Persians as a people/nation, typically appearing alongside Madai (Media) in compound expressions like 'Media and Persia'. S128625 covers conjunctive forms ('and Persia/Persians') while S128626 is the bare nominal form. Multilingual evidence is uniform: eng 'Persia/Paras', spa 'Persia', hin पारस, arb فُرْس/فَارِسَ, kor 바사, swa 'Waajemi'. The conjunction waw prefix is purely grammatical.
